overview: White and Black mirror each other with f-pawns and d-pawns on f4/d4 and f5/d5, a symmetrical Stonewall-like structure. Play continues with Nf3, e3, Bd3 and c4 or c3 with a slow fight over e5/e4 and a possible kingside attack after the pieces come out.

white_ideas.idea: Nf3, e3, Bd3 and castling with a Stonewall set-up
Attack on the kingside after Ne5

typical_structures.structure: Symmetrical Stonewall structure with pawns on d4/f4 versus d5/f5

character.notes: A mirrored position with a slow fight for small edges; little forcing play.

gambit.notes: No material is given on purpose in the main line.

approach.notes: A rare formation, but a respectable choice for players who know the structure.

character.reason: Symmetrical and slow without being especially Solid or Sharp.

approach.reason: Rare but respectable; not a system for use against everything.

plans.reason: Mirrored Stonewall pawns on d4/f4 and d5/f5.
